plugin.name: SiliconFlow
plugin.description: SiliconFlow's models for the agent, with your own API key.
plugin.longDescription: Adds SiliconFlow to Settings → Providers. Enter your API key here or in Settings and its models appear in the model menu; the list is read from SiliconFlow, so new models show up by themselves.
config.apiKey.title: SiliconFlow API key
config.apiKey.description: From cloud.siliconflow.com → API Keys. Its accounts are apart from SiliconFlow CN's.
